title: Frontend: Tabs Component
businessContext: Build and verify the core behavior behind Tabs Component. This independently authored exercise has a bounded, explicit contract. Injected clock, network, random, or worker models are identified in the contract; they do not claim production service guarantees.
problemStatement: Export App. Tabs One and Two link to panels First and Second. Initially One selected. Use tablist, tab, tabpanel, aria-selected, roving tabindex and matching ids. ArrowRight/Left wrap, Home/End select boundary and move focus; activation is automatic. Render only active panel.
constraints: Export default App. Only react and react/jsx-runtime imports are supported. The DOM contract and supplied props define the exercise.
Preserve identity, ordering, boundary behavior, and error messages stated in the contract. Passing fixtures verifies this contract, not every production concern.
candidateTasks: Implement the documented behavior without hard-coding fixture answers.
Run the full suite, investigate boundary failures, and explain the follow-up variation.
hints: Write down the state or algorithmic invariant, and trace the smallest boundary case before coding.
Maintain active and focused tab IDs according to a chosen manual or automatic activation model.
alternativeApproaches: Support vertical orientation and dynamic tab removal while preserving an understandable focus target.
commonMistakes: Ignoring contract boundaries such as: Arrow wrapping; Home/End; disabled tab.
Treating a local deterministic model as proof of durable storage, authorization, distributed coordination, or physical-world guarantees.
